CHAPTER.VERS: Be patient therefore, brothers, until the coming of the Lord. Look, the husbandman waits for the precious fruit of the earth, being patient over it, until it receives the early and latter rain.
Take, brothers, for an example of suffering and of patience, the prophets who spoke in the name of the Lord.
and the prayer of faith will save him who is sick, and the Lord will raise him up; and if he has committed sins, it will be forgiven him.
Elijah was a man of like passions with us, and he prayed fervently that it might not rain; and it did not rain on the earth for three years and six months.
And he prayed again; and the heaven gave rain, and the earth brought forth her fruit.
